marketing.anAiStaffMember: An AI staff member that works your leads
marketing.heroBody: Roster answers your calls and messages, finds new customers on Google Maps, and follows up with the ones you already have — then runs the pipeline, bookings and invoices around all of it.
marketing.runsOnYourServer: Runs on your server · PostgreSQL + Redis · Node 20+
marketing.nineJobsASmallBusiness: Nine jobs a small business pays four tools
marketing.featuresBody: Roster runs them from one database, so a phone call, a booking and an invoice all land on the same customer record without anyone copying anything across.
marketing.aiChatAndVoiceBody: Answers website chat, texts and phone calls from your own business details — never invented ones. Hands off to you when it should.
marketing.leadGenerationBody: Pick a niche and a region; Roster searches Google Maps and files the results as leads, skipping anything already on your list.
marketing.retentionEngineBody: Rules that fire on real events — quiet for 14 days, job completed, invoice paid — over email, SMS and push.
marketing.crmAndPipelineBody: Drag deals through your stages. Every call, message and email lands on the contact timeline automatically.
marketing.missedCallTextBackBody: Every missed call gets an instant text, so the job does not go to whoever picks up next.
marketing.bookingAndRemindersBody: Two-way Google and Outlook sync. The AI books genuinely open slots, and reminders go out 24 hours ahead.
marketing.reputationBody: Request reviews after each job, monitor what arrives, and let the AI draft your replies for approval.
marketing.invoicingAndPaymentsBody: Invoices and estimates with Stripe, Paystack or on-chain crypto. Payment status syncs back to the contact.
marketing.unifiedInboxBody: SMS, email, WhatsApp and website chat in one thread per customer, whichever way they got in touch.
marketing.installOnYourServerBody: Upload, run the installer, point it at Postgres and Redis. Every prerequisite is checked before anything is written.
marketing.addYourOwnKeysBody: Anthropic or OpenAI for the AI, Twilio for calls and texts, Stripe or Paystack for payments. Traffic goes straight from your server to them.
marketing.tellItAboutTheBusinessBody: Hours, services, prices and a few FAQs. The agent quotes from exactly that and refuses to invent anything you have not listed.
marketing.faqDataA: On your server, in your Postgres database. Roster never proxies your traffic — AI requests go straight from your install to Anthropic or OpenAI using your key.
marketing.faqFeeQ: Is there a monthly platform fee?
marketing.faqFeeA: No. You pay once for the script, then only for what you actually use — your AI provider, Twilio, and your hosting.
marketing.faqVoiceQ: What if I do not want the AI answering calls?
marketing.faqVoiceA: Every module is independent. Run it as a CRM with invoicing and never switch on voice, or use the retention engine alone. Nothing depends on anything else being configured.
marketing.faqWhiteLabelQ: Can I white-label it for my own clients?
marketing.faqWhiteLabelA: Yes. Logo, accent color and email templates are per workspace, and agency mode adds sub-accounts so each client gets their own isolated space.
marketing.faqRequirementsQ: What do I actually need to run it?
marketing.faqRequirementsA: Node 20 or newer, PostgreSQL and Redis. A small VPS handles it comfortably — the background worker and the web process are the only two things to keep running.
marketing.installItOnYourOwn: Install it on your own server
